correctness.rationale: The complete 107-tetrahedron data set reconstructs f=(17,124,214,107). Contracting a spanning tree gives 108 graph-cycle generators. Unimodular reduction of all 214 facial relations gives Smith form diag(1^106,4,4), proving H1=(Z/4)^2. The tracked column basis gives exact quotient coordinates. Exhaustion of all 519 graph triangles gives 214 faces and 305 nonfaces; every nonface is nonzero, all 15 nonzero homology classes occur, and the exact unoriented multiplicity spectra are 52,51,51,48,45,38 for order-four inverse pairs and 13,5,2 for nonzero order-two classes.

value.rationale: G6 has finite first homology (Z/4)^2, so its shortest integral cycle layer is a natural torsion-sensitive combinatorial systolic invariant. The result is stronger than a count: every empty triangle is essential and every one of the 15 nonzero homology classes is realized at the absolute minimum length. The sharply nonuniform class multiplicities further refine information invisible from the homology group and face vector alone.
